title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.6.9 Images Security Update
description: A security update has been released for the Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.6.9 images addressing a vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-117691. This vulnerability involves a SAML redirect binding signature bypass via percent-encoded parameter names. The update provides new container images for use within the OpenShift Container Platform to fix this issue.
